examples.en: My aunt Jennifer is an actress.
examples.zh: 我的姑姑詹妮弗是一位女演员。

examples.en: My aunt often visits us.
Her aunt is an actress.
examples.zh: 她的姑姑是一位女演员。

examples.en: She is a famous actress.
examples.zh: 她是一位著名的女演员。

examples.en: She must be at least thirty-five years old.
examples.zh: 她至少也有三十五岁了。

examples.en: The tickets cost at least ten pounds.
She often appears on the stage.
The sun appeared after the rain.
She appears on the stage as a young girl.
examples.zh: 她以小姑娘的形象出现在舞台上。

examples.en: The actors walked onto the stage.
She will take part in a new play soon.
examples.zh: 她不久将参加一部新剧的演出。

examples.en: We saw a play last night.
This time she will be a girl of seventeen.
examples.zh: 这一次她将扮演一个十七岁的少女。

examples.en: The girl is very pretty.
She wore a bright red dress.
examples.zh: 她穿着一件鲜红色的连衣裙。

examples.en: The room is bright and clean.
She must appear in a bright red dress.
examples.zh: 她必须穿着一件鲜红色的连衣裙出场。

examples.en: Her dress is very beautiful.
She wore long black stockings.
These stockings are new.
She had to wear short socks.
I bought three pairs of socks.
If anyone ever asks her age, she never answers.
examples.zh: 要是有人问她的年龄，她从不回答。

examples.en: Have you ever been to London?
She always answers with a smile.
Please answer my question.
It must be terrible to be grown up!
The weather was terrible yesterday.
She does not want to be grown up.
Her son is a grown man now.
examples.zh: 她的儿子现在已经是成年人了。

sentences.zh: 在剧中，她必须穿着一件鲜红色的连衣裙和黑色的长筒袜。

article.en: My aunt Jennifer is an actress.
article.zh: 我的姑姑詹妮弗是一位女演员。

article.en: She must be at least thirty-five years old.
article.zh: 她至少也有三十五岁了。

article.en: In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl.
article.zh: 尽管如此，她却常常在舞台上扮演小姑娘。

article.en: This time, she will be a girl of seventeen.
article.zh: 这一次，她将扮演一个十七岁的少女。

article.en: In the play, she must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings.
article.zh: 在剧中，她必须穿着一件鲜红色的连衣裙和黑色的长筒袜。

article.en: Last year in another play, she had to wear short socks and a bright, orange-coloured dress.
article.zh: 去年在另一部戏里，她不得不穿短袜和一条鲜艳的橘黄色连衣裙。

article.en: If anyone ever asks her how old she is, she always answers, 'Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!'
article.zh: 一旦有人问她有多大年纪，她总是回答：‘亲爱的，长大成人真是糟糕透了！’
